parts.name: next-boot.js
parts.contract: Released fragment routes, exact session identity, shared copy/re-entry controls outside session detail and escaped display helpers; store selectors belong to DRC-4822.

parts.name: next-observed.js
parts.contract: Source-backed shared session/project/history/risk/capacity selectors preserve provenance and absent versus measured facts.

parts.name: next-attention.js
parts.contract: Exact-owner asks, gate/risk queues, outcomes, coverage and ended-session distinctions stay visible without invented urgency.

parts.name: next-notify.js
parts.contract: Browser permission, fresh notification edges, native/browser lane ownership and reporting remain explicit and deduplicated.

parts.name: next-cockpit-compat.js
parts.contract: Temporary sessKey/fmtDur/lastData/render seam supplies the timeline and terminal substrate without mounting a second shell; remove after DRC-4824 and DRC-4826 consumers migrate.

parts.name: project.js
parts.contract: Shared semantic timeline, graph filters and redraw-safe substrate disclosures; preserve exact-session read-only terminal lifecycle with DRC-4824 and retire unused legacy renderer.

parts.name: next-chrome.js
parts.contract: Navigation, breadcrumbs, keyboard history/focus, header counts, project More utilities, refresh/build notices and stable copy/raise live-region cues.

parts.name: next-capacity.js
parts.contract: Usage consent gates credential fetching; capacity bars, model sublimits, pacing, expiration and source absence remain truthful.

parts.name: next-sessions.js
parts.contract: Session-first active/blocked/ended/source-gap groups, collision-safe identities and goal/drift row summaries; shared Intent semantics belong to DRC-4825.

parts.name: next-projects.js
parts.contract: Project list and history groups retain member identities, progress and source-backed summaries.

parts.name: next-project.js
parts.contract: Project detail rejoins raw Spacedock strips/task totals, revision/goal helpers and scope navigation before composing cockpit.

parts.name: next-intent.js
parts.contract: Intent log membership, retained-word provenance, revision/reading limits, source-aware load/retry and exact session links.

parts.name: next-activity.js
parts.contract: Active and finished sessions, observed subagent activity and completed tasks retain payload order and measured counts.

parts.name: next-session.js
parts.contract: Exact session detail, initial unread/outside-payload state, asks/answer confirmation, last reply and delegated-work evidence; Intent controls migrate with DRC-4825.

parts.name: next-workstream.js
parts.contract: Bounded observed/seeded workstream changes, observed-since coverage and persistent collapse choice.

parts.name: next-delegation.js
parts.contract: Delegation metrics/trends and Console rail retain their own collection/window; waiting and capacity widgets coordinate with DRC-4827.

parts.name: next-controls.js
parts.contract: Local project steering/guardrails and workflow-stage tripwires preserve drafts, revision-safe actions and busy state; bounded transport migrates with DRC-4822.

parts.name: next-cockpit.js
parts.contract: Recovery briefing, scoped project tabs, utility menu, human memos and semantic timeline; explicitly delegate shared Intent editor/analysis/review to DRC-4825 and terminal to DRC-4824.

parts.name: next-render.js
parts.contract: View dispatch and refresh coordinator preserve observer/usage consent, request freshness, revision handling and deferred paints during open native choices or motion.

parts.name: next-live.js
parts.contract: One lease-elected live connection per board namespace, SSE revision wakeups, fallback polling and bounded teardown.

surfaces.name: primary-navigation
surfaces.contract: Sessions, Attention, Projects and Intent remain keyboard reachable with current-location semantics.

surfaces.name: breadcrumbs-and-history
surfaces.contract: Origin-aware session breadcrumbs, Escape and browser Back return to the correct preceding scope.

surfaces.name: header-counts-and-block-control
surfaces.contract: Header running/subagent/block totals share exact observed identity and lead to Attention without claiming missing liveness.

surfaces.name: refresh-build-and-history-notices
surfaces.contract: Failed refresh, history reset and newer server build are distinct reader-visible notices that do not fabricate a fresh success.

surfaces.name: stable-status-and-alert-regions
surfaces.contract: Status and alert nodes remain persistent outside the replaceable app subtree; repeated actions and StrictMode must not duplicate announcements.

surfaces.name: session-copy-and-terminal-raise-controls
surfaces.contract: DEC-27 removes ID, link and command copies from Sessions rows and session detail. Shared CopyControl cues remain on Attention, the waiting panel, project rail and gallery; terminal raise remains explicit, capability-bound and deduplicated.

surfaces.name: sessions-first-screen
surfaces.contract: Active, blocked, ended and source-gap rows expose exact goals and drift with one-step access to a session.

surfaces.name: session-detail-and-absence
surfaces.contract: Exact-harness session detail distinguishes first unread payload from absent/expired identity and explains every unmeasured fact.

surfaces.name: session-questions-and-answer-confirmation
surfaces.contract: Every exact ask stays in payload order; one numeric option index is posted and only confirmed answers retire the question.

surfaces.name: session-last-reply-and-delegated-work
surfaces.contract: Last reply, tasks, workers and delivery/departure evidence preserve owner, source boundaries, counts and observed end state.

surfaces.name: intent-log
surfaces.contract: All eligible session membership and retained intent/reading/departure rows preserve provenance and exact links even with an empty project label.

surfaces.name: intent-goal-and-outcome-editor
surfaces.contract: Goal and outcome drafts, counters, save/undo and stale revision refusals preserve typed words, caret and native editing continuity.

surfaces.name: prompt-adoption-menu
surfaces.contract: Prompt previews and Keep actions bind selected source and revision; late arrivals/refusals never silently approve unseen direction.

surfaces.name: drift-explanation-and-live-monitor
surfaces.contract: Live estimates and model readings show the actual drift in words, times/evidence and limitations; monitoring choice does not imply a new model reading.

surfaces.name: analyze-notice-and-reading-result
surfaces.contract: Only explicit authorized Analyze starts work; notice/destination, durable off switch, revision floor, pending/error/withheld/completed state and result cues remain correct.

surfaces.name: correction-to-copy
surfaces.contract: Steer back reveals an editable bounded correction and explicit Copy; never writes it to the underlying session.

surfaces.name: departure-review-and-reading-history
surfaces.contract: Recorded raises, review/dismissal, delivery and superseded revision state remain separate source-backed collections with honest absence. No legacy web surface calls the dismiss route, so the React page builds no dismissal control.

surfaces.name: projects-list-and-history
surfaces.contract: Project groups preserve stable identity, member counts, recorded plans and active versus historical state.

surfaces.name: project-detail-and-workflow-plans
surfaces.contract: Project header/goal/revision and Spacedock definitions, stage/task progress, plans and empty discovery retain original source facts.

surfaces.name: project-scope-tree-and-switcher
surfaces.contract: Project root and exact focused session remain different scopes on desktop rail and compact disclosure; stale focus explains its absence.

surfaces.name: project-recovery-briefing
surfaces.contract: Assignment, execution, command, latest exact direction/result and absence/authority sources stay front and center.

surfaces.name: project-more-utility-menu
surfaces.contract: Project-only More menu exposes Copy briefing and conditionally Add human context, while retaining all-project status.

surfaces.name: human-context-memo
surfaces.contract: Outcome/current focus memos remain browser-owned, bounded, scoped and explicitly editable without becoming observed agent facts.

surfaces.name: project-now-and-activity
surfaces.contract: Now shows current/finished session activity, progress and plans with source-backed counts and disclosed detail.

surfaces.name: project-course-and-completed-work
surfaces.contract: Course displays changes, exact/derived episodes, stage conditions and completed-work evidence without turning a review into verified success.

surfaces.name: project-decisions-semantic-timeline
surfaces.contract: Decisions shows scoped semantic work items/lanes, evidence, recorded decisions and persisted active/all/decisions filter; it is distinct from session detail.

surfaces.name: project-console-operating-rail
surfaces.contract: Console presents delegation/waiting/capacity operations before setup, preserves exact selected-session scope and progressive disclosures.

surfaces.name: project-steering-and-local-tripwires
surfaces.contract: Project steering bar and local guardrail drafts survive refresh; local-only controls remain explicit about their enforcement limits.

surfaces.name: workflow-stage-tripwires
surfaces.contract: Saved stage rules preserve source/revision, suspension/unavailable states, safe explicit save/remove and request focus.

surfaces.name: workstream-changes-and-delegation-trends
surfaces.contract: Bounded source-observed windows, collapse preference and delegation comparisons never substitute missing history with zero.

surfaces.name: exact-session-terminal-registration-recipe
surfaces.contract: Console registration is two numbered steps behind a redraw-safe disclosure; absent/refused/disabled bridge reasons and exact zero coordinates remain readable.

surfaces.name: read-only-terminal-output-and-viewport
surfaces.contract: Loopback vendored xterm, output-only socket, reconnect/dispose, short output, preserved viewport, follow and Jump to live stay scoped to one exact session.

surfaces.name: attention-gates-risks-and-coverage
surfaces.contract: Attention orders exact questions/checkpoints, risks and gate metadata without erasing lower-priority evidence; healthy/unmeasured coverage remains explicit.

surfaces.name: capacity-model-sublimits-and-pacing
surfaces.contract: Capacity shows measured overall/model limits, expiration and project spread; stale, absent and true zero differ.

surfaces.name: usage-consent-disclosure
surfaces.contract: Usage fetching is offered with disclosure; declined/unanswered consent sends no usage parameter and reads no credential.

surfaces.name: notification-permission-and-ownership
surfaces.contract: Explicit browser permission and server/native lane ownership avoid duplicate notifications and preserve reporting across refresh.

surfaces.name: observer-model-request-controls
surfaces.contract: Console observer controls distinguish unread capability from disabled and require an explicit exact request with the server off switch and a non-blocking notice without automatic model invocation.

surfaces.name: live-update-and-fallback-continuity
surfaces.contract: SSE, leader election, wakeup and poll fallback preserve monotonic freshness and a single in-flight revision read.

surfaces.name: disclosure-motion-and-native-input-continuity
surfaces.contract: Disclosure open state, popover position, focus, IME, Base UI Select popup lifetime and input drafts survive source refresh; actual browser checks supplement VM assertions.

routes.name: bare-or-invalid-fragment
routes.contract: Bare or malformed #n token canonicalizes to #n=sessions without creating a dead project filter.

routes.name: top-level-intent
routes.contract: #n=intent reaches the Intent log and only source-aware entry triggers its load.

routes.name: project-root
routes.contract: #n=project:<encoded project> preserves identity and defaults to Now.

routes.name: project-tabs
routes.contract: #n=project:<encoded project>:course|decisions|console preserves tab, panel and keyboard wrap; Now is the canonical default.

routes.name: project-exact-session-focus
routes.contract: #n=project:<encoded project>:<encoded harness:sid>[:tab] preserves exact focused session, distinct project scope and stale-focus explanation.

routes.name: session-exact-harness-and-id
routes.contract: #n=session:<encoded project>:<encoded harness>:<encoded sid> distinguishes identical ids across harnesses and permits an empty project.

routes.name: session-legacy-id-form
routes.contract: Released #n=session:<encoded project>:<encoded sid> remains parseable without silently matching an ambiguous wrong owner.

routes.name: session-origin-from
routes.contract: Closed &from=sessions|attention|intent|projects|project controls crumb, active tab and Escape after reload; unknown origins are omitted.

routes.name: retired-held-to-alias
routes.contract: #n=project:<project>:<encoded harness:sid>:held-to aliases to exact session detail rather than treating the retired slug as focus.

routes.name: malformed-encoding-and-empty-project
routes.contract: Malformed percent encoding never names the valid empty-project session, and absent focused sessions remain bounded.

routes.name: absolute-session-permalink-query
routes.contract: Retired under DEC-27: session Copy link and its unused absolute-link builder are removed; exact session routes remain bookmarkable.

routes.name: all-query-data-scope
routes.contract: Only ?all=1 extends data URL scope; usage=1 is consent-derived, never inferred from unrelated URL flags.

routes.name: retired-next-query-refusal
routes.contract: HTTP rejects retired ?next=true|false|empty aliases while canonical root and ?all=1 serve the one released UI.

routes.name: browser-history-and-escape
routes.contract: Hash navigation and canonical replaceState preserve browser Back, origin-aware Escape and the stable document title.

reader_state.name: An open disclosure
reader_state.contract: Controlled Accordion and Collapsible derive value/open from the subscribed keyed store. Independent siblings remain open together; trigger focus and the 220 ms motion hold survive polls. hiddenUntilFound publishes beforematch revelation; hashes are reapplied after panel mount for fresh-load targets. Controlled Popover derives open from the same store and mounts inside the app root with automatic focus disabled. Only native menus retain toggle version precedence; remounts replay no opening motion.

reader_state.name: An open run of checks
reader_state.contract: Run openings follow the shared disclosure store by project, exact session scope and oldest member id, across refreshes, remounts and a new check at the newest end. Failed, earlier-failed, cited, selected-finding and file-written entries split runs and remain listed.

reader_state.name: Loaded session record pages
reader_state.contract: Hold pages across polls and manual refresh only while the exact project/session page is open. Read newest fifty once per opening; read older pages only on Show more. Dedupe by fact_id, abort and drop on leave, restart stale once. Never persist or prefetch. Recompute numbers from the oldest loaded entry in the intent window.

reader_state.name: An expanded Attention section
reader_state.contract: Expanded Attention sections survive revision/reordering; collapsed initial-three display remains reader-controlled.

reader_state.name: Intent log rows
reader_state.contract: Token invalidation immediately withholds withdrawn rows; visible view fetches once, hidden view waits; stale generations cannot restore words.

reader_state.name: The selected quota window
reader_state.contract: Keep vendor/window identity even below initial three; choose an existing fallback only when absent, clear when none remain.

reader_state.name: Keyboard focus
reader_state.contract: Retain actual focused keyed node; on removal use exact fallback. Preserve offscreen focus without scrolling; never interpolate hostile keys in selectors.

reader_state.name: A row control's confirmation cue
reader_state.contract: Copy/raise confirmation belongs to lane+harness+sid; 30s TTL and newest32 keys, never a persistent session fact.

reader_state.name: A typed and unsent draft
reader_state.contract: Unsent steer/tripwire drafts remain per project in memory; submit clears both live node and draft before a new snapshot.

reader_state.name: That draft's caret offset
reader_state.contract: Draft caret/selection offsets stay with the exact editor/project; clamp offsets only against that editor's text.

reader_state.name: The `+ set a tripwire` box, once opened
reader_state.contract: Opening set-a-tripwire stays open for the tab; Escape cancels its draft without changing the route.

reader_state.name: A workflow stage-condition choice, save cue and action focus
reader_state.contract: Keep stage draft/cue/busy per workflow id; restore action focus after final enabled render only without later interaction; identical stage preserves server latch/revision.

reader_state.name: An open Select popup
reader_state.contract: React retains the controlled value and open popup. Defer background board paints while actually open for at most 12 consecutive holds; popup closure catches up once. Manual and cap paints retain popup identity.

reader_state.name: A disclosure the reader just toggled, mid-motion
reader_state.contract: Reader toggle motion lasts200ms; background/context commits coalesce for220ms; reader actions and reduced motion do not wait.

reader_state.name: The workstream panel's collapse
reader_state.contract: Workstream collapsed preference survives reload; storage failure retains the tab's toggle.

reader_state.name: The timeline's activity filter
reader_state.contract: Keep active/all/decisions per project+session map, with explicit caller mode > stored choice > default; reload and sibling projects remain independent.

reader_state.name: The prototype terminal viewport scroll offset
reader_state.contract: Keep terminal viewport offset/follow state, clamp to actual scroll maximum, live cursor view and2px follow threshold; explicit jump resumes following.

reader_state.name: Cockpit scope and selected tab
reader_state.contract: Preserve fragment scope/tab/history and session origin; retired held-to becomes exact session route, not a tab/fallback session.

reader_state.name: Cockpit disclosures and the mounted terminal
reader_state.contract: Keep scope/criterion+entry disclosure identities and armed-discard warning; Base UI prompt trigger has one focus key. Terminal resource retention is owned by4824, not ordinary route unmount.

reader_state.name: Cockpit human context
reader_state.contract: Human outcome/focus autosave500 UTF-16 units per project+scope+field; retain in memory and show error on failed storage.

reader_state.name: An unsaved goal or expected outcome checklist in the session page's drift block
reader_state.contract: Keep unsaved goal/list/origins in memory only, cap from annotate_cap(default240), six lines; preserve late edits/refusals and freeze adoption+lines against locked saved_revision.

reader_state.name: A prompt chosen from "Use your prompt" or an explicit later direction, not yet saved
reader_state.contract: Chosen adoption is fact id+words+source time, not typed draft; drop only matching adopted choice, never a newer in-flight choice.

reader_state.name: Selected later direction and prompt-menu choices
reader_state.contract: Keep selected later-direction id and once-per-opening prompt list per session in memory; revalidate listing, keep-or-clear answer until save/undo.

reader_state.name: A later direction opened by "Add as a line" or "Update intent instead", pending review
reader_state.contract: Hold whole pending direction text/source/replacement in memory; no maxlength truncation, live count/refusal; duplicate Add focuses same draft, missing source/removal clears. A direction draft opened from record pages keeps its words across leaving while older pages are unread; only a loaded origin or a complete record can reconcile absence.

reader_state.name: Steer back open
reader_state.contract: Steer back open/in-flight state survives redraw, suppresses duplicates, closes on second press and temporarily hides during analysis/question; reload drops.

reader_state.name: The correction draft
reader_state.contract: Keep correction parts/stamp/text/edit/copy state, recompose unedited stale source only;2000 code points, native insertion/undo cap handling, whole composition refusal and explicit fallback.

reader_state.name: The correction's native editor and active composition
reader_state.contract: Retain same native editor/undo during focused authored text and IME. Queue latest payload; leaving pointer waits through actual click, Tab/cancel/navigation release; provisional text never copied.

reader_state.name: The correction's Copy cue
reader_state.contract: Correction Copied/Copy unavailable lasts tab until accepted edit; recomposition disables copying and copying freezes exact text without claiming reader authorship.

reader_state.name: The whole text of each direction Keep opened before settling
reader_state.contract: Keep holds whole directions and the drawn revision. Its first press reads and shows every direction, a new arrival is unread, and a later settlement names that drawn revision. The count-only question permits no one-press settlement.

reader_state.name: The live monitor switch in the session page's Drift section
reader_state.contract: Live monitor is session-local1/absent browser preference with tab-memory fallback; only toggles displayed deterministic cues, never server/model behavior.

reader_state.name: An outline entry chip pressed in What the session has done
reader_state.contract: A chip press opens the Full activity disclosure and focuses the entry's row, reading older record pages for a prompt the page does not hold; only the latest press settles. The "Full activity does not show" sentence stays across board refreshes until the next press and goes with the session page. The outline is the focused context's, redrawn each board revision, and nothing is stored.

reader_state.name: The summary's notice, and the answer to Turn off summaries
reader_state.contract: The notice the last summary start's reply carried is held per session in memory until a later start's reply replaces or clears it, or Turn off summaries clears every held notice; a running job's own notice stands in when none is held. The grant is the server's; a consent reply is drawn over only the board it answered. The once-per-page-load open start is marked in the same entry before anything is sent, and Delete summary sets it. Nothing reaches browser storage.

reader_state.name: A summary's progress
reader_state.contract: The job is the focused context's, redrawn each board revision; the job a 202 named is drawn only until a focused read made after that answer. No per-part announcement. A press's refusal or lost answer is held per session until the next press.

reader_state.name: An open citation in a summary
reader_state.contract: As an outline chip: the press opens Full activity and focuses the entry's row, reading older record pages by fact id within the page cap, so every chip lands or says it could not be loaded. Only the latest press settles. The sentence a press leaves stays until the next press.

reader_state.name: The Full activity target, and the jumps between a summary phase and a departure
reader_state.contract: The full-activity disclosure key is written open and the entry focused on the reader's press only; a summary that lands moves no focus and replaces no node an edit lives in. The phase and departure headings are focused only by the jump buttons. Which phase holds a departure is derived each render; nothing is stored.

reader_state.name: A finding selected in the session result
reader_state.contract: The selected finding is held by session key, reading time and finding key across refreshes. Fact ids resolve again to current activity rows and numbers; only a press focuses and scrolls. A new reading, unavailable citations, navigation away or reload removes the marks. Nothing is stored or requested.

reader_state.name: A Not accurate mark the store did not take
reader_state.contract: Unsaved Not accurate error remains per session for tab; actual mark/aria-pressed derive from payload, not optimistic local state.

reader_state.name: The drift block's save cue
reader_state.contract: Save/discard cues use30s TTL and last16 keys; typing clears save cue, discard arm expires and has1.2s dwell; server owns discard outcome.

reader_state.name: The two live regions the drift block's cues are written into, and the last sentence written to either
reader_state.contract: Persistent polite/assertive live nodes preexist announcements; dedup per standing key,last16; repeat Keep resets guard; retract armed warning silently when arm ends.

reader_state.name: Context editor focus, caret and internal scroll
reader_state.contract: Context editor keeps focus,selection,inner scroll; Escape from field or Done restores entry value and closes without another persistence meaning.

reader_state.name: A draft input's internal scroll and resized dimensions, even after focus leaves it
reader_state.contract: Exact-key native input retains unfocused caret,inner scroll,width/height; textarea sizing stays fixed to respect a remembered drag; line resize follows index after deletion, never transfers to another session.

reader_state.name: The More menu
reader_state.contract: More summary/open state survives unrelated updates and remains keyboard reachable.

reader_state.name: The More menu's copy-briefing result
reader_state.contract: Copy-briefing outcome has no TTL and is shown only for matching project/session context key; preserve exact clipboard result.

reader_state.name: Project plan, raw status, earlier Course entries, other directions, and the tier-2 caveat bodies in the drift block and on Sessions
reader_state.contract: Per project/scope/session disclosures subscribe independently to versioned snapshots; multiple siblings may open together. Sessions caveats have no project. Controlled Popover callbacks write the store. Escape closes all popovers and returns focus to the event owner or the first trigger in document order. Outside press and focus departure close without returning focus; window blur leaves open. The portal stays in the app root; polls preserve popup identity and focus. Menus keep their no-Escape contract.

reader_state.name: Project-level semantic timeline disclosures, and Console's terminal-registration recipe
reader_state.contract: Project-scope timeline and terminal recipe disclosures keep independent project ids/open state and summary focus, even with no focused session.

reader_state.name: A reader-requested reading in the drift block
reader_state.contract: Reading pending/latest feedback and notice survive scope changes for tab; successful no-notice reply clears notice, pending/lost/refused press keeps it, running job notice survives reload; duplicate press suppressed; local refusal disappears when its reason changes; payload eligibility wins.

reader_state.name: A control's in-flight request
reader_state.contract: Per-control request token owns busy/cue/timers:400ms start,15s abort,5s backstop; late handler cannot clear newer request; no rearming on keystroke.

reader_state.name: Whether Analyze can be pressed, as the drawn Drift card last showed it
reader_state.contract: Analyze/Keep visual eligibility keeps last16 drawn session states; closing requires two payloads+10s, line30s, announce at most60s; pending freezes and press resolves held state.

reader_state.name: A Cancel on a running analysis
reader_state.contract: Cancel feedback is keyed by exact job id, duplicate requests refused; server cancelling flag survives reload; old failure never appears under new job.

reader_state.name: A running analysis this tab has seen, and whether its box was drawn
reader_state.contract: Prime existing jobs silently on load; announce new drawn job once and new stored/withheld outcome once; hidden/unannounced end removes stale live text.

reader_state.name: Observer model request status and notice
reader_state.contract: Observer summary uses the server off switch; payload notices name destinations; explicit request only, per-session pending/result keeps redraw; passive stale read cannot replace requested result.

reader_state.name: The document scroll offset
reader_state.contract: Browser clamps document scroll; unrelated update does not focus-scroll a previously offscreen control, only intersecting old target may move view.

reader_state.name: A text selection over rendered text
reader_state.contract: No synthetic text Range restoration or clipboard action. Stable nodes may retain native highlight; do not restore it over changed text.

reader_state.name: The Intent how-to popover
reader_state.contract: How Intent and drift works is keyed by project and exact session identity, persists across redraws and remounts for this tab, and uses shared Popover dismissal/focus rules without browser storage.

reader_state.name: A direction action's refusal
reader_state.contract: The exact question, goal, activity-row or Update intent control holds its own refusal across polls until the next press or an intent edit; a persistent polite region announces it, and failure retains that control focus without filling an editor. Exact session keys keep another session's feedback.

reader_state.name: A Full activity row's Source sentence
reader_state.contract: Closed until the reader presses the row's Source toggle; kept open across redraws, a board refresh and a remount under the disclosure key entry-source:<entry id>, scoped by project and the activity list's scope. A plain button over the keyed disclosure store, not a Disclosure.

reader_state.name: Why a run of hidden summary lines was hidden
reader_state.contract: Closed until opened; kept open across redraws and a refreshed summary under summary-hidden:<phase place>:cites:<cited entry ids>, so a shifted run does not open another run's reasons. A run that cites nothing is keyed by its place.

reader_state.name: The departures the last drawn reading carried, and what the next reading cleared
reader_state.contract: Held for the life of the tab, one per session, bounded at 16, never stored. A later reading with no departure, after one this tab drew with some, is named once as clearing them, and the reading after it takes the line down; a reload says nothing.

storage.name: compass.cockpit.memo.v2:
storage.contract: Human outcome/focus stay browser-local and exact project/scope; memory survives failed persistence, with visible error.
storage.format: Key prefix + encodeURIComponent(unique project_key else label) + ':' + encodeURIComponent('project' or harness:sid) + ':' + outcome|focus; raw string,500 UTF-16 units via slice/maxlength, no TTL or key-count cap; memory read wins.

storage.name: compass.next.graph.mode
storage.contract: Reload and cross-project/session filter choices stay independent; invalid legacy empty-scope key is discarded.
storage.format: One JSON object map {'<project>\u0000<session-or-empty>':'active'|'all'|'decisions'}; loader requires exactly two NUL-separated parts and valid mode; no TTL or map-count cap; caller pinned mode > stored > default > active.

storage.name: compass.next.guardrails.
storage.contract: Tripwires are browser preferences, never instructions sent to a session; older string rules remain readable.
storage.format: Key prefix + encodeURIComponent(project); JSON array of {text:string,enabled:boolean}; accepts old strings as enabled; trim+slice500 UTF-16 units,drop empty/invalid,enabled only false disables,first50 rules; no TTL/project-count cap; tab memory survives failures.

storage.name: compass.next.leader
storage.contract: Use released namespaced lease only; cross-tab sole stream owner, private storage fallback and pagehide release preserved.
storage.format: Fixed key; JSON {id:random-base36+'-'+Date.now(),ts:Date.now() milliseconds}; renew2000ms/stale6000ms; one lease, no payload-size bound in loader; foreign owner causes current leader to yield even when stale; failed storage makes tab self-lead. Clearing a legacy value writes an empty new key to suppress fallback on reload.

storage.name: compass.next.live-estimate:
storage.contract: Switch changes display only, persists only for exact harness/session, defaults off and retains tab answer on storage failure.
storage.format: Key prefix+harness+':'+sid (sessKey, no URL encoding); raw '1' means on, absent/other value off; off removes key; no TTL/session-count cap; in-memory choice wins after a local toggle. Clearing a legacy value writes an empty new key to suppress fallback on reload.

storage.name: compass.next.revision
storage.contract: Storage fan-out only not a durable acceptance/snapshot; duplicate/older stream events do not refetch.
storage.format: Fixed key raw server revision '<started>.<counter>'; comparator splits last '.', changed start treated newer, invalid counter falls back to inequality; no TTL/length bound; read via storage event, last revision memory, not hydration from persisted key.

storage.name: compass.next.usage.consent
storage.contract: Unanswered is distinct from declined/granted; no credential fetch before disclosure, storage error retains tab answer.
storage.format: Fixed key raw 'granted'|'declined'; missing/unrecognized null then in-memory fallback; no TTL; valid storage consulted before memo so another tab's answer can win.

storage.name: compass.next.workstream.collapsed
storage.contract: Stored workstream collapse survives reload with in-memory fallback; legacy unnamespaced storage not adopted.
storage.format: Fixed key raw '1' collapsed or '0' expanded; only '1' is true on load, missing/invalid expanded; no TTL; toggle updates memory before attempted persistence.

storage.name: compass.observer-model-consent.v1
storage.contract: Retired browser answer retained for storage compatibility only; it never gates goal summaries. The server off switch and explicit press govern requests.
storage.format: Fixed key raw 'granted'|'declined'; missing/unrecognized falls back to null/memo; no TTL; storage consulted first, setter memo before write; not qualification or Analyze authorization.

storage.name: compass.projectCockpitProject
storage.contract: Dormant legacy project selection is still inventoried; retain encoding/rollback compatibility without promoting it to a current session route.
storage.format: Fixed key raw project-label string, missing/empty becomes null; no TTL,length/count cap; project.js boot reads it, old setProjectCockpit writes; current shared seam suppresses old navigation handlers and uses #n routes.

storage.name: compass.projectGoal.v1:
storage.contract: Dormant browser project focus remains separate from durable intent and memo.v2; do not migrate into a different scope silently.
storage.format: Key prefix+encodeURIComponent(label); raw trimmed saved string,clear removes key; old editor maxlength500 UTF-16 units but storage read/write do not enforce a raw length bound; no TTL/key-count cap; draft memory wins. Clearing a legacy value writes an empty new key to suppress fallback on reload.

storage.name: compass.projectUsage.v1
storage.contract: Dormant legacy project-use ordering remains compatibility data, not observed activity or React sort authority.
storage.format: Fixed key JSON object label=>count; loader takes first200 entries,Math.floor(Number(value)),positive only,each<=999999; writes increment/clamp but do not bound total key count; no TTL; malformed/blocked storage yields in-memory fallback.
